name: livepersona
description: Interactive avatar conversation system with interruption-aware dialogue

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @livepersona/core && concurrently -n core,server,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @livepersona/core" "npm run dev -w @livepersona/server" "npm run dev -w @livepersona/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @livepersona/core && npm run build -w @livepersona/server && npm run build -w @livepersona/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @livepersona/core && npm run test -w @livepersona/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @livepersona/core && npm run typecheck -w @livepersona/server && npm run typecheck -w @livepersona/web
